context: Patch the optional-dependency boundary while preserving the real from_config/deployment path; do not weaken the production error when a user selects local mode without chDB.
description: Run 30434746317 has nine local-mode ClickHouse introspection/plan-capture tests fail in PlatformAdapter.from_config because chDB is unavailable on Windows. The tests intend to exercise tuning and plan logic with mocked clients, not optional-driver installation.

deferrals.reason: Two notes from independent triage of Nightly run 30473819253. (1) The support decision is already made in-tree: pyproject.toml declares chdb>=0.10.0; sys_platform != 'win32' in three places with the comment 'not available on Windows', so a platform skip with a recorded reason is the sanctioned outcome here rather than loosened assertions. (2) Implementation detail that matters: key the skipif on importlib.util.find_spec('chdb') is None rather than on sys.platform, so the guard stays honest if chdb ever ships Windows wheels AND provably does not over-skip on Linux, where chdb IS installed and these tests must continue to run. (3) Count: the 'test (windows-latest, 3.12)' job shows 17 'requires chDB' failures, so the title's 9 appears to undercount - worth confirming before closing on a count-based rung.
deferrals.resolved_reason: Merged fix is probe-based rather than sys.platform-based and current Nightly no longer contains the 17 chDB-family failures; the undercount is historical metadata, not open code work.
deferrals.summary: Key the skip on chdb availability, not sys.platform; title's '9 failures' undercounts

preserves.behavior: real local ClickHouse configuration still raises an actionable missing-chDB error

verifications.description: ClickHouse introspection and plan-capture tests pass

work_units.evidence: Merged PR #1352 adds a non-autouse chDB probe fixture explicitly requested by the two mocked local-mode modules; current focused tests passed and latest Nightly has no chDB family failures.
work_units.summary: Isolate the nine mocked local-mode tests from chDB availability
